1	"""Campaign compiler, typed replay, filtering, and state preparation.
     2	
     3	This module is the offline pipeline:
     4	
     5	1. compile the campaign configuration into typed model objects;
     6	2. compile one plan per entry (module order, declaration order, symbolic
     7	   harness slots, ``bad_input`` flag and reserved identifier count);
     8	3. recover each recorded KTEST strictly against that harness;
     9	4. evaluate the entry predicate and every composed filter application, and
    10	   check the flag attestation;
    11	5. prepare the deterministic minimum state preamble;
    12	6. assemble the canonical corpus, where a model result is only a witness.

    42	class TypeTable(object):
    43	    """Named type definitions, resolved lazily and canonicalised per name."""
    44	
    45	    __slots__ = ('definitions', 'cache')
    46	
    47	    def __init__(self, definitions):
    48	        table = {}
    49	        for item in definitions:
    50	            table[item['name']] = item
    51	        self.definitions = table
    52	        self.cache = {}
    53	
    54	    def get(self, name) -> Type:
    55	        cached = self.cache.get(name)
    56	        if cached is not None:
    57	            return cached
    58	        definition = self.definitions.get(name)
    59	        if definition is None:
    60	            raise ConfigError('unknown type name ' + repr(name))
    61	        kind = definition['kind']
    62	        if kind == 'bool':
    63	            node = Bool(name)
    64	        elif kind == 'char':
    65	            node = Char(name)
    66	        elif kind == 'int':
    67	            node = Int(definition['bits'], name)
    68	        elif kind == 'string':
    69	            node = String(definition['maxsize'], name)
    70	        elif kind == 'void':
    71	            node = Void(name)
    72	        elif kind == 'enum':
    73	            node = Enum(name, definition['values'])
    74	        elif kind == 'array':
    75	            node = Array(None, definition['size'], name)
    76	            node.element_type = self.get(definition['element'])
    77	        elif kind == 'struct':
    78	            node = Struct(name, {})
    79	            fields = {}
    80	            for (field_name, field_type) in definition['fields']:
    81	                fields[field_name] = self.get(field_type)
    82	            node.fields = fields
    83	        elif kind == 'alias':
    84	            node = Alias(name, None)
    85	            node.type = self.get(definition['target'])
    86	        else:
    87	            raise ConfigError('unknown type kind ' + repr(kind))
    88	        self.cache[name] = node
    89	        return node
    90

    92	def convert_constant(node_type, value):
    93	    """The JSON value representation of a typed constant (never truncated)."""
    94	    inner = Type.inner(node_type)
    95	    if isinstance(inner, Bool):
    96	        return bool(value)
    97	    if isinstance(inner, Char):
    98	        return value
    99	    if isinstance(inner, Int):
   100	        return value
   101	    if isinstance(inner, String):
   102	        return value
   103	    if isinstance(inner, Enum):
   104	        return value
   105	    if isinstance(inner, Array):
   106	        element = inner.element_type
   107	        return [convert_constant(element, item) for item in value]
   108	    if isinstance(inner, Struct):
   109	        fields = inner.fields
   110	        return {name: convert_constant(fields[name], value[name]) for name in fields}
   111	    return None
